name: Holo2 235B-A22B
notes: Hub API at revision f7f85b14 lists 96 BF16 safetensors shards (about 235.7B parameters) in the Qwen3VLMoeForConditionalGeneration architecture; the repository is not gated. H Company's models page calls this release a research preview. The card describes supervised fine-tuning followed by online GRPO on a mix of open-source, synthetic and human-annotated data, some of it proprietary, and reports localization scores including an iterative 'agentic localization' mode; those scores are the publisher's and were not reproduced. No weights were downloaded. The card declares conflicting licenses; see the license review.
summary: Research-preview Holo2 checkpoint, a 235B-total, 22B-active mixture-of-experts fine-tune of Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Thinking for UI localization and navigation on web, desktop and mobile screens.
